costs.note: Locked book. 10 pt = MT5 points (0.01), not 10 index points. RT ≈ $0.20 slip + ~$0.60 spread. Do not cut slippage or raise lots to chase 1%/20%.

reused_from_trading.clock_or: scripts/us_index_session_core.py NY cash 09:30–16:00 ET, causal 15m OR, prior_cash_close_series / cash_open_gap_pct
reused_from_trading.adx: Wilder ADX/DI algorithm from manual-trading-agent/src/indicators/adx.py, rewritten as a causal series on completed ET-day bars
reused_from_trading.htf_join: Same completed-bar grammar as completed_h4_ema_bias / completed_daily_donch_state: forming ET day is excluded
reused_from_trading.exog_shape: as-of feature_end <= m5_bar_open; predictor-only sign; traded T* isolation — symbols/hours are NEW (FP XAUUSD.r H1, ET 07:00–09:00), not the XAU leak
reused_from_trading.mtf_join_idea: crypto-agent multi_timeframe_regime: HTF state known first, then LTF entry. Not its thresholds.

hurst_fallback_preregistered.primary: R/S Hurst on the last L completed daily closes (price levels, mean-adjusted cumulative deviate). L in {32, 64} is a frozen grid, not fit on this CSV.
hurst_fallback_preregistered.when: Hurst is NaN / non-finite / R<=0 / S<=0

variance_ratio.on: log-returns of the same L completed daily closes
variance_ratio.persist_if: VR > 1.0 (treated as Hurst 0.56 for the >0.55 test)
variance_ratio.revert_if: VR < 1.0 (treated as Hurst 0.44 for the <0.45 test)

hurst_fallback_preregistered.note: Fallback locked before any Hurst/VR was computed on US100 daily closes. Do not fit L or k on this tape.

daily_regime_switch.note: AND-gate daily state from completed ET-days only (today's Daily/ET-day is forming — unused). Momentum day → 15m OR close-break only. MR day → gap fade vs prior cash close only. Chop → hard-flat. Mixed conditions → chop. Not a v4 vol_regime_orb retune. Not the failed ORB+VWAP+EMA AND-gate.
daily_regime_switch.daily_source: Resample full ET-day OHLC from US100 M5 (not Daily.hc; read_mt5_hc_m5 rejects step>3600).
daily_regime_switch.atr_expanding: last completed day's ATR > 60th percentile of the N completed days immediately before it (scored day excluded)
daily_regime_switch.atr_compressed: last completed day's ATR < 40th percentile of that same prior-N window

momentum_setup.entry: close-break after 09:45 ET, entry_end 11:30, one/day, Friday >=14:00 blocked
momentum_setup.exit: no fixed TP; initial SL ATR 1.0 then trail; flatten 15:45 ET

mr_setup.trigger: gap fade vs prior cash close (cash_open_gap_pct). ONE primary. Not VWAP-deviation. Not ORB+VWAP+EMA.
mr_setup.entry: first cash bar (mins>=09:30); fill = next M5 open
mr_setup.vwap_target: session VWAP from completed NY-cash bars strictly before the current bar (running, causal)
mr_setup.flatten: 11:30 ET or on touch of the mean

london_xau_fx_risk_gate.note: Gate the same day's US100 15m OR close-break by a London-window XAU risk read. Not US30. Not hours {7,8,9}. Not joint_london_open_cosign_fade_flat.
london_xau_fx_risk_gate.predictor: FP XAUUSD.r H1.hc on ~/.mt5-fpmarkets (same prefix / server_utc_offset_sec=10800 as US100). Convert server epoch − 10800 → UTC → America/New_York.
london_xau_fx_risk_gate.window: ET 07:00–09:00 (H1 bars whose ET open hour is 7 or 8). Last bar closes 09:00 ET. feature_end = 09:00 ET. First usable US100 bar open >= 09:00; NY cash entries still >= 09:45.
london_xau_fx_risk_gate.displacement: close(08:00 ET H1) − open(07:00 ET H1)
london_xau_fx_risk_gate.range_vs_atr: |displacement| >= min_disp_atr * Wilder ATR(14) at the 08:00 ET H1 (completed)
london_xau_fx_risk_gate.gate: require sign(XAU displacement) == sign(US100 OR close-break)
london_xau_fx_risk_gate.tstar_isolation: XAU H1 bars with ET hour >= 9 (including the 09:30 hour) do not enter the predicate
london_xau_fx_risk_gate.exit: same momentum trail set; flatten 15:45; initial SL ATR 1.0; no TP

london_fx_predictors.why: FP EURUSD/GBPUSD H1.hc exist on the same prefix, but the live cache last stamp is 2026-08-14 12:00 ET (charts not open) while US100 runs through 2026-08-18. A partial intersection would silently drop days. Vantage eurusd_h1.csv / gbpusd_h1.csv are server_clock_as_stored and must not be naive-joined to FP M5. xauusd_data.csv +00:00 is not UTC.

vantage_xau_h1_join.why: instrument_data/xauusd_h1.csv and xauusd_data.csv are Vantage server clocks. Protocol + v5 already forbid treating +00:00 as UTC or stamping hours {7,8,9} onto FP M5.

us30_predictor.why: v5 proved US30 is the same trade, not an exogenous read.

rank_develop: net>0 and trades>=40; rank by profit_factor then expectancy
